decisions.reason: As a recent launch close to the firm's established range and already publicly presented, it is likely to be retained while management justifies its investment and gives it more time in a growing market.
Because this articulated construction dumper extends the core business and has visible market commitment, management is likely to persist unless clearer evidence of failure emerges.

Although this mine rescue vehicle is more distant from the established offer and therefore more vulnerable, its recent launch and public commitment still make continued support more likely than withdrawal within the next year.
A newly launched product line with several models implies comparatively high development and commercialization investment, so escalation of commitment strongly favors keeping it on the market.
